description: Welcome to 834 Congo Street, a beautifully updated and light-filled home in the heart of highly sought-after Glen Park, one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods. Known for its village-like charm, vibrant shops and dining, and close proximity to nature, this location offers a unique blend of urban convenience and community warmth. Walk to Glen Canyon Park, BART, and Glen Park Village! This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence features a desirable single-level bedroom layout at the rear of the home, with generously sized rooms and great closet space throughout. Large windows and multiple skylights fill the home with natural light, highlighting beautifully refinished oak floors that extend through most of the living spaces. The expansive living room offers a warm and inviting setting, complete with a charming wood-burning corner fireplace. The large, sunny kitchen is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring brand new appliances, ample cabinetry, and an open dining area. Designer-selected lighting throughout adds a modern, polished touch. One bedroom includes sliding glass doors that open to a rear deck and backyard, offering excellent potential to create a custom outdoor retreat. The yard's natural slope and existing deck provide an opportunity for terracing, landscaping, and personalization. Additional highlights include a huge two-car side-by-side garage with interior access, exceptional storage space, owned solar panels installed in 2014, and freshly painted interior and exterior for move-in-ready appeal. Built in 1962, this home blends classic character with thoughtful updates in a prime Glen Park location. A rare opportunity to own a bright, well-located home with space, flexibility, and upside in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
